description: Defines an abstract base class for rendering thick and thin barcodes with adjustable ratios, handling rendering details such as rotation, bar width, and text placement within a PDFsharp-based barcode drawing library.

classes.name: ThickThinBarCode
classes.description: An abstract base class for barcode types that use thick and thin bar rendering, providing methods for rendering bars, gaps, and text with configurable ratios and rotation.

methods.name: InitRendering
methods.description: Initializes rendering parameters for the barcode, including dimensions and orientation based on direction.

methods.name: RenderBar
methods.description: Renders an individual bar (thick or thin) based on the isThick parameter.

methods.name: RenderGap
methods.description: Renders a gap between bars, either thick or thin.

methods.name: RenderTurboBit
methods.description: Renders a thick bar before or after the barcode to enhance scanning or aesthetics.

methods.name: RenderText
methods.description: Renders text associated with the barcode at specified location.

methods.name: GetBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates width of a bar or gap based on the ratio and the thin bar width.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate the width of thin bars, to be implemented by subclasses.
